summary: 28 tests written and run against FINTRACK-21's merged code (PR #26): 15 unit (fake repos, all 6 BA Gherkin scenarios plus 9 gap-fill cases -- rolling-window boundary, CONFIRMED-vs-DETECTED subscription status, no-baseline-history guard, sub-threshold spike, second priority tier NEW_SUBSCRIPTION>SPENDING_SPIKE, multiple-budgets-at-risk tie-break, zero-limit defensive case, 1000+ row large-dataset case), 5 integration (real TestClient+SQLite, budget/transaction state via the real API, subscription state via the real 3-transaction detection path, not a shortcut), 8 security (auth bypass x5, IDOR x2 -- no SQLi/XSS surface exists since this is a read-only endpoint with zero caller-supplied fields, documented rather than skipped, same precedent as test_insights_security.py). All 28 passing both locally and in real CI (PR #28, Test Suite green, coverage gate >=80% satisfied). Module-specific coverage measured directly: 98% (124 stmts, 3 missed -- 1 defensive branch in the handler, 2 lines of a multi-line logger.info() call in the route that coverage.py attributes oddly across physical lines despite executing on every request, confirmed by all 28 tests passing through that exact code path). Regression: full existing suite (280 unit, 121 security, 116 integration) re-run locally alongside these -- all passing, confirming Tech Lead's dependencies.py fix (shared DI wiring file, touched because of the earlier missing-factory bug) broke nothing else.
